scgpt_continual.corpus: scGPT whole-human plus supervised Tabula Sapiens cell-type training

interpretation: GSE289173 was submitted and made public in February 2025, after the June 2023 whole-human and December 2023 continual output files. The continual model's Tabula Sapiens supervision is a generic external cell-type objective, not exposure to GSE289173 or its frozen endpoint labels; it is therefore target_label_unexposed for the held-back source. This does not make the two checkpoints scientifically equivalent: their self-supervised and externally supervised results must be reported separately, and scgpt_continual is continual_seen on any Tabula Sapiens evaluation. Sources public before the whole-human cutoff remain unknown until the exact retired Census build can be queried.
remaining_blockers: Obtain approved weight artifacts and record their SHA-256 without executing checkpoint content.
Resolve whether the downloadable weights have terms separate from the MIT code repository; undeclared weight terms block an open champion.
Inspect the PyTorch archives and stage state dictionaries without unrestricted pickle execution.
Reconstruct exact membership of the retired 2023-05-08 CELLxGENE weekly build for pre-cutoff development sources.
Freeze and probe an executable runtime, including deterministic per-cell token sampling for common-lane embeddings.
Do not transfer this audit to organ-specific, pan-cancer, perturbation, later, or undeclared scGPT checkpoints.
